integrity_notes: Direct mathematical proof and exact rational finite reproducibility controls. Same-model review only; no independent evaluation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to proper double stars with at least two leaves at each hub, and strictly positive transmission proportion and threshold at most one. The sixteen indicators are evaluated by a fixed three-round recurrence rather than written as a piecewise semialgebraic chart. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sixteen-state transmission-forcing census for proper double stars
